page.overview:
Who is Croo?

Once the is open, Link can talk to Croo, where he will tell the hero how to sleep in a bed to pass time. He also warns Link that Skyloft is different at night. If Link sits in the seat opposite to Croo, he congratulates his graduation and offers a drink. If Link denies the offer, Croo will feel insulted; but if Link accepts, Croo tells him that he could become a Rescue Knight if he works hard, and boasts that his grandson is one. Afterwards, he will invite Link to visit him again for information. Croo also provides additional pieces of wisdom, such as the nature of their home, Skyloft, and that Hylia is the one responsible for their lives on the floating island. Croo also tells Link of "ring-shaped rocks," which the hero can use to propel himself through the sky. He also tells Link about the usefulness of Stamina Potions that can be bought from the Potion Shop.

Croo's name is likely derived from , and possibly the cooing of birds.
